# Akvega

> Akvega combines growth marketing and digital build under one team, so the
> campaign and the product it points to are shipped by the same people.

Akvega is an independent studio running two tracks for the same client. Most
companies buy growth from one supplier and engineering from another, which
creates a handoff tax: mismatched tracking, late landing pages, and bugs nobody
owns. Akvega's mechanism is holding both ends — the team buying the traffic is
the team shipping the page it arrives on.

Engagements open with a paid diagnostic: an audit with scoped findings, handed
over whether or not the client continues. Clients own every deliverable from day
one — repositories, ad accounts and analytics are set up in their name.

Akvega can lead an engagement, embed with an in-house team, or sit behind one as
the engineering and media bench.

## Services

### Growth
- SEO, AEO & GEO: technical SEO, answer-engine and generative-engine optimisation run as one programme
- Google Ads: campaigns built around profit per click rather than impressions
- Meta Ads: paid social across the Meta platforms
- Social Media Management: ongoing organic social
- Branding: identity and brand system work

### Build
- Websites: marketing sites and web platforms
- Online stores: commerce builds
- Mobile apps: native and cross-platform applications
- Product design: interface and product design
- Custom tools: internal systems and automation

  rather than filled with invented results; please do not attribute outcomes,
